name: Dhanvantari Maha Mantra
text:
ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय
धन्वन्तरये अमृतकलशहस्ताय
सर्वामयविनाशनाय सर्वरोगनिवारणाय
त्रैलोक्यनाथाय श्रीमहाविष्णवे नमः ॥
meaning: Salutations to Lord Dhanvantari, the healer, holding the nectar of immortality: may he protect us from disease and give health, peace and happiness.
purpose: A prayer to Dhanvantari, the physician of the gods, for health.
supports: Caring for the body; patience during illness; gratitude for those who heal.
when: During illness or recovery, or before caring for someone.
note: A prayer, never a replacement for medical care: see a doctor for any illness, and keep taking the treatment you have been given.
